python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
r=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for x in r[80:85]:a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],answer=next(k for k,v in x['options'].items() if v=='baseline dot'),confidence='high',note=''))
open('answers.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(x)+'\n' for x in a))
b=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(r)==len(b)==85
assert [x['item_id'] for x in r]==[x['item_id'] for x in b]
assert len({x['item_id'] for x in b})==85
assert all(y['answer'] in x['options'] for x,y in zip(r,b))
assert all(y['confidence'] in ['high','low'] for y in b)
print('Validated count, order, unique IDs and option letters.')
print(dict(collections.Counter(x['options'][y['answer']] for x,y in zip(r,b))))
print('Low confidence:',sum(y['confidence']=='low' for y in b))
